QuestInfo.name: Is This Okay?
QuestInfo.0: Let Tina know that Blake's done with his styling preparations.
QuestInfo.1: Tina looks disgusted with Blake's poor attitude. She wonders how ANY stylists could possibly work with a jerk like him. Lana should probably know about this.
QuestInfo.2: Lana looks worried after hearing about Tina.

0.0: Blake agreed to wear the fedora? That's progress, I guess. Well, maybe not...he'll throw a fit if an article about his lousy  fashion gets out. Ugh, I don't know.
0.1: You have no idea how many stylists have left that Grumpy Gus. Marshall's on the verge of quitting as well. Let Lana know about this.

yes.0: No one will want to work with Blake at this rate.

no.0: Lana should have a solution. Please reconsider.

1.0: What? Marshall might quit? Well, Blake finally crossed the line. Maestro Rho also mentioned something about not wanting to work with Blake anymore.

yes.0: I'll talk to Marshall, so could you ask Maestro Rho to continue working with Blake? The most important asset for a singer is his music, so we can't afford to lose him now.

npc.0: You have no idea how many stylists have left that Grumpy Gus. Marshall's on the verge of quitting as well. Let Lana know about this.
